claim_scope: Research-only evidence that Rust GlobalEconomicStateV1 and GlobalEconomicEffectPlanV1 enforce their existing semantic row ceilings during sequence deserialization. Exact-limit JSON decodes, maximum-plus-one rejects, exact-size hints reject before reading an item, streaming JSON rejects without consuming a hostile tail, mounted economic-initial-state input maps an oversized nested state to Decode, and accepted canonical bytes and roots remain unchanged.
failure_modes: a Rust decoder materializes a global state or effect-plan vector beyond its semantic V1 ceiling
an exact-size sequence reserves or reads an item after declaring an oversized length
a streaming sequence consumes attacker-controlled tail data after observing the first excess row
a mounted economic-initial-state input prepares an oversized nested global state
a valid V1 state changes canonical bytes or state root after bounded decoding is introduced

aaa.reason: The tests arrange exact-limit and maximum-plus-one sequence inputs, invoke direct Rust deserialization or the mounted canonical guest decoder, and assert successful exact-limit decoding or fail-closed decode rejection with no prepared statement or effect.

reject_is_noop.reason: Deserialization is an immutable admission boundary. A rejected sequence constructs no accepted state, effect plan, witness, receipt, or external effect.

boundary_dimensions.name: global_state_vector_cardinality
points: all ten vectors decode at their exact 12, 256, or 4096 limit
all ten vectors reject at their own maximum plus one

boundary_dimensions.name: global_effect_plan_vector_cardinality
points: all six vectors decode at their exact 12, 256, or 4096 limit
all six vectors reject at their own maximum plus one

boundary_dimensions.name: sequence_decoder_behavior
points: an oversized exact-size hint rejects before the iterator's first next call
a JSON sequence with maximum plus one valid rows rejects before parsing a malformed following tail

boundary_dimensions.name: mounted_guest_boundary
points: a valid nested state reaches canonical mounted processing
an oversized nested state maps to Decode before statement preparation

mutations.description: remove or raise any bounded deserializer on the ten global-state or six effect-plan vectors
reserve from an oversized exact sequence hint or consume the hostile tail after the first excess item
let the economic-initial-state decoder materialize an oversized nested global state

nonclaims: This packet grants no production, settlement, publication, verifier, migration, release, or value-moving authority.

The wire-decode claim covers GlobalEconomicStateV1 and GlobalEconomicEffectPlanV1 only; the remaining GlobalSettlementABI V1 collection fields require a separate exact inventory before any whole-ABI resource-safety claim.
Mounted inputs retain independent outer byte ceilings, and this packet does not establish proof-cycle feasibility at every admitted maximum.
The Python canonical encoder's exact-type admission, cycle, depth, aggregate-item, and byte limits are separate obligations.
Passing these tests does not close O-008, any whole-value-movement gate, or the whole-program release gate.
